note: 与其他 Emissary 共享台词模板,详见 Emissary_Braum.json 的说明和 GLOSSARY.md。

messages.context: 无进行中委托时的开场白,要胡萝卜(国王最不喜欢的蔬菜,想讨好他)
messages.text: The King's least favorite vegetable is carrot, so he sent me, his favorite emissary, to make it better!
messages.zh: 国王最不喜欢的蔬菜是胡萝卜,所以他派我这个他最喜欢的委托官来把它变得好吃点!
messages.raw: §fThe King's least favorite vegetable is carrot, so he sent me, his favorite emissary, to make it better!

messages.text: I'm sure that by giving him his least favorite vegetable, he'll make me his favoritest emissary!
messages.gloss: 'favoritest' 是游戏里故意用的非标准最高级(favorite 的儿童化夸张说法),翻译时可以用类似“最最最喜欢”的夸张语气对应,不需要逐字直译。
messages.zh: 我肯定,只要把他最不喜欢的蔬菜献给他,他就会封我当他“最最最喜欢”的委托官!
messages.raw: §fI'm sure that by giving him his least favorite vegetable, he'll make me his favoritest emissary!

messages.context: 拒绝/取消委托时的台词,带自我怀疑的语气
messages.text: I'm not sure if the carrots would have worked anyways...
messages.zh: 我其实也不确定胡萝卜到底管不管用……
messages.raw: §fI'm not sure if the carrots would have worked anyways...
